description: Get the receipt of a mined Ethereum transaction: success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use eth_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x9531467e03a57bbb5cd080439ac3b10c0cefed147282eb2ff709b02c897afcbf. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: eth_receipt
title: Ethereum transaction receipt
